messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Good mornin'{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Listen, don't let this
weather get you down.
{07 0d 00}Don't pout! Play! Jump in a
puddle! Enjoy the rain!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Tere hommikust{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Kuule, ära lase sel ilmal
end kurvaks teha.
{07 0d 00}Ära mossita! Mängi! Hüppa
lompi! Naudi vihma!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Goood morning{01 07 00}!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}! You look like
you're enjoying the rain.
You know.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} {07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}If there's one
thing I hate, it's that wet
human smell, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!

Rainy days always make me
feel a little{01 00 00 05 00} nostalgic,
you know, {04 1f 00}?
It reminds me of how I
used to feel...{01 00 00 05 00}

Staring outside and
watching the rain fall.
messages.et:
Vihmased päevad teevad mu
alati natuke{01 00 00 05 00} nostalgiliseks,
tead küll, {04 1f 00}?
See meenutab mulle, kuidas
ma varem tundsin...{01 00 00 05 00}

Aknast välja vaadates ja
vihmasadu silmitsedes.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh, hi{01 07 00}!
Isn't it a nice day? I just
love the rain.
{07 19 00}Rain washes away all the
dirt and makes everything
feel new, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Which is all well and good,
but I'm getting a little
sick of it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh, tere{01 07 00}!
Kas pole kena päev? Mulle
lihtsalt meeldib vihm.
{07 19 00}Vihm peseb ära mustuse
ja teeb kõik uueks,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}See on kõik hea ja ilus,
aga mul hakkab sellest
natuke kõrini, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
Tell me something,
{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}Do you like
rainy days?
{07 14 00}I do. I like them quite a
bit, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

It's almost like the world
has been veiled in the
sound of falling rain.
I love that quiet time when
all I can hear is the sound
of raindrops.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
Ütle mulle midagi,
{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}Kas sulle meeldib
vihmane päev?
{07 14 00}Mulle küll. Mulle meeldivad
nad päris palju, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

On peaaegu nagu maailm
oleks loori taha peidetud
sadava vihma helis.
Ma armastan seda vaikset
aega, kui kuulen ainult
vihmapiisku.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} is that you? {01 00 00 0a 00}I
haven't seen you all day!

{07 0b 00}Where have you been?
Scampering about in the
rain, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}You know what? I kind of
like walking around in the
rain, too, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} oled see sina? {01 00 00 0a 00}Ma
pole sind päeva näinud!

{07 0b 00}Kus sa olnud oled?
Sähvid vihma käes
ringi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Tead mida? Mulle meeldib ka
vihma käes ringi
jalutada, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Well, well! Good evening{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0b 00}Did you waste your whole
day inside today?
Reading a book, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 00 00}drinking a
cup of {04 18 00},
maybe watching a movie?
{07 14 00}Now that I think about it,
that's not a bad way to
spend a day, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Noh, noh! Tere õhtust{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0b 00}Kas sa raiskasid terve
päeva toas?
Lugedes raamatut, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 00 00}juues
tassi {04 18 00},
võib-olla filmi vaadates?
{07 14 00}Nüüd kui ma mõtlen, pole
see halb viis päeva
veeta, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Oh, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Good evening{01 07 00}!

{07 00 00}It's cold, it's getting dark,
and this rain just won't let
up, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 19 00}I think it's just about time
I went home and had a nice,
hot cup of tea.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Oh, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Tere õhtust{01 07 00}!

{07 00 00}On külm, läheb pimedaks
ja see vihm ei anna
järele, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 19 00}Ma arvan, et on just aeg
minna koju ja juua kena
kuum tass teed.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Wow{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 0b 00}What on earth are you doing
out in this rain?
{07 00 00}Is something bothering
you? Is the rain getting
you down?
{07 14 00}Well, don't you worry!{01 01 00}
{07 19 00}This rain won't last
forever, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Vau{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 0b 00}Mida sa küll siin vihma
käes teed?
{07 00 00}Kas miski vaevab sind?
Kas vihm teeb sind
kurvaks?
{07 14 00}Noh, ära muretse!{01 01 00}
{07 19 00}See vihm ei kesta
igavesti, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Good evening{01 07 00}.
The rain always makes me
feel a little poetic.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
Deep upon the night, 
The rainfall echoes sweetly.
Clouds begin to break.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Tere õhtust{01 07 00}.
Vihm teeb mind alati
natuke poeetiliseks.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
Sügaval öös, 
vihmasadu kajab magusalt.
Pilved hakkavad hajuma.
